headline: Smurfit Westrock (SW) Is Hunting For Acquisitions To Drive Its Next Phase Of Growth
summary: Smurfit Westrock (NYSE:SW) used its second quarter 2026 results webcast to confirm it is actively seeking acquisitions. Management also pointed to future growth opportunities via additional investments in the business. This focus on acquisitions marks a potential shift in how the company may expand its operations.
